text:
jonah: quick q — for the 2.3.5 patch tonight, do we pin the minor or just patch? we hit that kv-cache edge case in runtime, worried about rollout and rollback windows.

maya: i'd prefer patch-only (2.3.5) unless there's API surface change. pinning minor (2.4.x) feels heavy for a bugfix.

samir: agree patch. question is tagging convention — do we keep buildmeta like `+hotfix.1` or strip it for stable patches?

lia: for our releasebot checks it's easier if patch tags are clean semver `v2.3.5` and any ephemeral metadata goes in the release notes. buildmeta has proven confusing in dependency resolution.

jonah: ok. what about deploy-bot behavior during the change window? canary then staggered rollouts? we need a clear rollback plan if latency regressions show up.

maya: runbook recommandation: canary (5%), wait 15m with perf probes, then 25% for 30m, then full. rollback condition: p95 latency > baseline + 40ms or error rate > 0.5%.

samir: +1. also put an automatic pin fallback to previous patch if deploy-bot sees sustained errors for 3 consecutive minutes.

devops-runner: deploy-bot: noted. We can set deploy policy: {"canary":5,"canary_wait_mins":15,"staged_steps":[25,70],"metrics_monitor":"p95_latency,error_rate"} — will add to the job.

lia: small thought: when we do rollback, should we create a `v2.3.5-rollback1` tag or just re-tag the previous `v2.3.4` as latest? I prefer tagging rollback artifacts explicitly for auditing.

maya: explicit rollback tag is better. use `v2.3.5-rollback.1` and include the good commit SHA in the tag message.

samir: agreed. runbook snippet we should add to ops playbook:

```
# Rollback procedure (short)
1) Abort staged rollout via deploy-bot
2) Create rollback tag: git tag -a v2.3.5-rollback.1 <good-sha> -m "rollback: revert to <good-sha> due to latency_regression"
3) push tag and trigger deploy-bot promote-to-stable
4) open incident with perf trace link
```

jonah: perfect. one more: release notes format. ops and docs want a single-line summary plus impact matrix. proposal:
- Summary: "fix: kv-cache invalidation under long sequences"
- Impact: "no API changes; potential latency improvement on small inputs; rollout in change-window"
- Rollback: link to rollback tag

lia: sounds good. add a short reproduction snippet in the body for SRE.

devops-runner: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for v2.3.5 at 2026-11-02T02:00Z, policy applied. Will post progress updates in thread.

release-bot: releasebot: created release v2.3.5 (sha: ab12cd34), notes saved to drafts. Reminder: set `release-notes/public=true` if this should be announced.

jonah: thanks all — action items: maya write runbook PR, samir update tagging docs (explicit rollback tag), lia add repro to release note template. i'll monitor canary.

maya: i'll open PR in next 20m.

samir: updating docs now.

lia: adding repro and pinging support to watch.

devops-runner: deploy-bot: canary started (5%). posting telemetry link: https://telemetry.internal/runs/1799123456

jonah: on call and watching :eyes: will report any regressions here.
